merge_and_claim_boundaries: This only measures named NodeIo recv and recv_timeout(Duration::ZERO) over preloaded bounded queues on Darwin arm64. Queue setup, reference-order generation, and output allocation occur before the timer; timeout is a no-wait API comparison because each receive has a preloaded event.
It is not an end-to-end RuntimeGraphExecutor, graph scheduling, desktop, or application throughput result.

Both arm patches touch only src/graph/transport.rs and carry the same frozen benchmark module suffix. The measured candidate patch contains the performance source delta plus the ignored diagnostic test harness; use the separate product-only patch/review for product merge decisions, and keep benchmark harness inclusion as a separate choice.
The result supports the measured named-receive cases and their paired outcomes only; do not generalize the 847-source single-input reductions to all graph workloads or user-visible runtime speedup.
review: independent source-and-artifact audit of the named preloaded receive paired run
scope: Read-only audit of retained source, build, raw per-attempt, pair, and report artifacts. No Cargo/build/test/benchmark/API invocation was made during this review.

source_and_binary_identities.build_provenance: The pinned workflow iterates baseline then candidate; for each it cleans the release package, builds exactly one flow library-test artifact, copies it to a separate saved binary, and emits a receipt. Both Cargo JSONL artifact rows exactly equal their receipts; both artifacts report fresh=false following the explicit package clean.

verification.p50_recomputed_from: median of three retained raw duration_ns values divided by 54,208
verification.pair_order: AB/BA alternation resets at each phase; positions and actual timestamps are sequential with no overlap
verification.paired_delta: candidate p50 minus baseline p50, recomputed per measured pair and case
verification.paired_ratio: candidate p50 divided by baseline p50, recomputed per measured pair and case
verification.raw_hashes: Every attempt raw.json, stdout.bin, and stderr.bin SHA-256 matches the paired report; raw sample canonical oracle signatures and the independent recomputation match for all 102 attempts.
